official_measurement_examples.name: Environmental permit checker update
official_measurement_examples.fact: The permit checker was updated 2 March 2026 and distinguishes pollution, flood-risk and water-resources licensing routes.

official_measurement_examples.name: Water discharge guidance update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Water discharge/groundwater guidance was updated 20 April 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Standard sewage permits 2025 series
official_measurement_examples.fact: Standard rules SR2025 No 5, 6 and 7 were published/updated for qualifying domestic sewage discharges with specified volume limits.

official_measurement_examples.name: Flood-risk permit decision timing
official_measurement_examples.fact: EA guidance says flood-risk-only applications normally receive a decision within about 2 months, while combined/public-consultation cases normally take about 4 months.

official_measurement_examples.name: Flood-risk compliance guide update
official_measurement_examples.fact: EA published/updated flood risk activity permit compliance scoring guidance on 5 June 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Pre-application advice scope
official_measurement_examples.fact: EA pre-application advice guidance updated 1 May 2026 says the service will not confirm a proposal is suitable or likely to be approved.

official_measurement_examples.name: Surface-water risk assessment update
official_measurement_examples.fact: Surface water pollution risk assessment guidance was updated 20 February 2026.

official_measurement_examples.name: Legal operator distinction
official_measurement_examples.fact: Environmental permits require the correct legal operator and permit status does not substitute for planning permission.

core_rules: environmental permit is not planning permission
planning permission is not an environmental permit
permit checker result is not permit grant
permit application is not permit grant
standard rules availability is not site eligibility
standard rules permit requires all criteria to be met
bespoke permit requirement must not be inferred solely from development type
water discharge permit is distinct from flood risk activity permit
groundwater activity permit is distinct from abstraction licence
abstraction licence is distinct from planning permission
impoundment licence is distinct from planning permission
flood risk activity permit applies to main-river related regulated works not every watercourse
ordinary watercourse consent routes must remain distinct
main river map is not a parcel permission map
permit exemption is conditional and not unrestricted permission
general binding rules must not be assumed without evidence
clean rainwater exclusion does not cover contaminated runoff
enclosed pond exception must meet all conditions
temporary dewatering RPS is conditional and time-limited
RPS is not an environmental permit
pre-application advice is not approval
free basic advice is not a suitability opinion
enhanced paid advice is not permit pre-determination
risk assessment is not permit grant
surface-water screening result is not final permit limit
model result must retain input data and scenario assumptions
permit numeric limit is not planning condition
permit compliance is not proof land is uncontaminated
compliance assessment score is not Future Growth score
CAR report is not planning enforcement notice
permit inspection absence is not proof of compliance
permit variation application is not varied permit
permit transfer is not planning transfer
permit surrender is not site remediation certificate
flood-risk application consultation is not approval
permit notice publication is not grant
two-month flood-risk timing is typical not guaranteed
four-month combined/public consultation timing is typical not guaranteed
standard water-discharge form version must be date-checked
legal operator identity must match the permit holder
permit holder identity is not land ownership
water-company consent under section 166 is distinct from environmental permit
water-supply asset discharge route is not generic development drainage approval
pollution-control requirement must not be converted into parcel feasibility without evidence
NO_DATA must not become no permitting constraint
research confidence is not parcel permit accuracy
